Re: file · two follow-ups from #34884 (PR #34980) · 2026-11-17T21:04Z

Please file two follow-ups that area o3-C named while building #34884 (seat 3 does not draft cards):

1. **Hook and job bodies are not compile-checked.** PR #34980 adds the gating lint rule `action-body-does-not-compile`, which covers script action bodies inside the runtime wrapper `(async (input, ctx) => { … })`. Hook and job bodies (`async (ctx) => …`) get no equivalent check, so a body that can't compile is still found only at run time. Dedupe words: hook job body compile lint.
2. **Skills docs: `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`** teaches the action wrapper but doesn't warn against redeclaring `input` or `ctx` inside the body, which is exactly what #34980 now refuses. This is a skills-text card. Dedupe words: data-hooks wrapper redeclare input ctx.

> Non-grid views that bind a withheld (disabled-package) field
> 
> Follow-up to #34901 (PR #34979, grid/list only). All READ in code at d639b903f34; nothing run.
> 
> Field binding keys (packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts):
> - kanban: groupByField, summarizeField, titleField, columns
> - calendar: startDateField, endDateField, titleField, colorField, allDayField
> - gallery: coverField, titleField, visibleFields
> - timeline: startDateField, endDateField, titleField, groupByField, colorField
> - gantt: 16 *Field keys (start/end date, title, groupBy, parent, color...)
> - map: latitudeField, longitudeField, locationField, titleField, descriptionField
> 
> In ListView:
> - $select is safe: bindings pass addSpeculative, gated on served names (ListView.tsx:3931-3975, 4006-4040).
> - Calendar REACHES THE DOOR. calendarWindowFilter(window, start, end) (calendarWindow.ts:126-135) is merged into $filter at ListView.tsx:4296-4299, after the withheld drop. The fetch at ListView.tsx:4347 then gets 400 INVALID_FIELD.
> - Kanban does NOT reach the door:
>   - Lane paging needs the lane field's served options (ListView.tsx:3651-3661, ObjectKanban.tsx:741-756).
>   - ObjectKanban's query sends no $select or groupBy (ObjectKanban.tsx:964-975).
>   - Every card lands in Uncategorized.
> - withheldViewRefs (ListView.tsx:2858-2880) ignores view-type keys: no notice.
> 
> Standalone page blocks:
> - $orderby is built from schema.sort at ObjectKanban.tsx:970, ObjectCalendar.tsx:961, ObjectGantt.tsx:1072, ObjectTimeline.tsx:495 and ObjectMap.tsx:1100. A withheld sort gets 400 INVALID_SORT.
> - The calendar record anchor (ObjectCalendar.tsx:1041, initialDate.ts:73-76) also puts startDateField in its query. Its 400 ends up as a console.warn.
